title: Chip startup Agrani Labs looks to raise $108 million from Peak XV, Google, Samsung
summary: Chip startup Agrani Labs seeks 108 million dollar funding round led by Peak XV
detailed: Peak XV Partners is leading the round and is expected to contribute more than half of the total funding. Google, HCL Tech, Samsung Ventures and Stargazer, an investment firm set up by Groww's founders, are also expected to participate, the people cited above said.
